# Copilot Global Instructions

## Language

Always use **American English** spelling. Never use British English variants.

| Use | Never |
|-----|-------|
| initialize / initialization | initialise / initialisation |
| recognize / recognition | recognise / recognition |
| analyze / analysis | analyse / analysis |
| color | colour |
| behavior | behaviour |
| labeled | labelled |
| canceled | cancelled |
| dialog | dialogue |
| serialize / serialization | serialise / serialisation |
| authorize / authorization | authorise / authorisation |

This applies to all code comments, variable names, function names, documentation, and prose.
